title: ClearAir Readiness and Coordination Analysis
summary: Sources establish ClearAir Survey readiness as 'ready' on 2026-09-05. Both tbl-004 and video-tx-002 assert readiness status. However, video-tx-002 explicitly identifies as agent-authored synthetic transcript with no video/audio processed. It notes no Northline dependency and distinguishes Riverwatch sensor issues as unrelated to delay.

findings.qualification: Asserted in record; verified by synthetic transcript text.

findings.claim: Riverwatch sensor issue not evidence of delay

limitations: video-tx-002 explicitly states no video or audio was processed and is agent-authored synthetic.
No independent corroboration of coordination meeting beyond text transcription.
follow_up: Verify if synthetic transcript content matches independent record entries.
